pref.title: My currency
pref.desc: Every amount on the site is shown to you in this currency, at a daily reference rate. Everyone enters amounts in their own currency, and the original is always one hover away.
pref.saved: Saved to your account, so it follows you to other devices
pref.guessed: Guessed from your browser settings — you can change it

rikma.title: Rikma currency
rikma.desc: The rikma counts all its money in one currency — sales, splits and mission values. Each partner enters amounts in their own currency, the amount is converted at that day's rate, and everyone sees it in their own currency.
rikma.locked: Money has already been recorded in this rikma, so its currency can no longer be changed.
